brief: Gabriel, whose name means “man of God” or “God’s might has been shown”, is one of the three angels mentioned by name in the Bible. Gabriel assists Daniel to understand his vision, appears to Zechariah to foretell the birth of John the Baptist, and is the angel of the annunciation, bringing tidings to Mary that she is to have a son. Appropriately, Gabriel is honoured on the day before the Feast of the Annunciation.
